title: Autonomy health gate — establish≠operate
problem: Agents treat fleet core-status ok / harness inspect PASS / SYNCHRONIZED / ONLINE as healthy while autopilot critical, disk near-full, zombies, false bridge ONLINE.

solution.summary: Add a single autonomous health rollup command and fail-close inspect when rollup is critical.
steps: Create tnf-autonomy-health-rollup.cjs reading: core-fleet-latest.json, subdirector-autopilot-latest.json, df free+capacity%, bridge process+ttl, thin-client zombie ratio from redis/list sample, handoff head_sha vs git HEAD.
Emit JSON + one-line status: healthy|degraded|critical with reason codes.
Wire `tnf autonomy health` (or `tnf fleet health`) that prints rollup.
Change harness inspect to call rollup; if critical, overall FAIL (fail-closed) while still listing individual checks.
Document in tnf menu Day-1 / Core Ops: after alive, run autonomy health before claiming ready.
verify: tnf autonomy health --no-splash; expect non-zero exit when status=critical
When disk restored and autopilot healthy, exit 0
solution.rollback: Feature-flag TNF_AUTONOMY_HEALTH_FAIL_CLOSED=0 restores prior inspect PASS behavior.

acceptance_probe: Rollup critical ⇒ harness inspect fails; rollup healthy ⇒ inspect can pass rails checks.
conflicts: None with adversarial dual full-auto — health gate observes, does not kill loops.
